title: Interface window file
source: the fact base: CGui::LoadKey, CWindowType::LoadKey with its 28 tokens, CGuiType::LoadKey and CEU3DialogGuiType::LoadKey (reversing/findings/FINDINGS-gui.md, FINDINGS-guicontainers.md section 3, FINDINGS-guilive.md section 3); ParseGuiOrientation. The element kinds' own loaders are not read: their keys come from OpenHOI3's reader (lib/OpenHOI3.Content/Gui/CGuiTypes.cs) and from the mod's and the base game's files

file.desc: a .gui file: CGui::LoadKey reads `guiTypes` and drops every other key in silence, so a file that opens with an element loads nothing

guiTypes.desc: the file's elements; the only key a .gui file is read for

guitypes.desc: the elements of a .gui file, each found by its name

positionType.desc: a named position the game's code reads

scrollbarType.desc: a scrollbar, which list boxes name

editBoxType.desc: a box the player types in; the base game declares one at the top level

window.desc: a window: CWindowType::LoadKey's 28 keys and CGuiType's 5

name.desc: the element's name, by which the game's code finds it

dontRender.desc: read by every element (CGuiType); usually written empty

pdx_tooltip.desc: a tooltip key, read by every element (CGuiType)

pdx_tooltip_delayed.desc: the delayed half of a tooltip, read by every element (CGuiType)

scope.desc: read by every element (CGuiType); no file uses it

background.desc: the name of the element drawn as its background

position.desc: its position: an { x = y = } pair of whole numbers

size.desc: its size: an { x = y = } pair of whole numbers; fullScreen overwrites it with the screen's

moveable.desc: 1 lets the player drag it; read as a number, not yes/no

fullScreen.desc: yes stretches it to the screen

click_to_front.desc: yes brings it to the front when clicked

orientation.desc: the corner or middle of the parent the position is measured from. The game compares the word exactly, capitals and all, and takes anything else for UPPER_LEFT without a word

upsound.desc: the sound played as it opens

downsound.desc: the sound played as it closes

multiSpriteButtonType.desc: a button variant sharing guiButtonType's type class; neither the mod nor the game uses it

3dButtonType.desc: a button whose graphic is an objectTypes entry; neither the mod nor the game uses it

editBoxType.desc: a box the player types in

checkboxType.desc: a checkbox: a button type that toggles

threeDguiType.desc: a screen-aligned 3D element; neither the mod nor the game uses it

OverlappingElementsBoxType.desc: a box whose entries overlap to fit

dialog.desc: a dialog window: a window and `shieldtype`
